category: Threat Modeling tools (incl. AI-assisted threat modeling and threat modeling of AI/agentic systems) - market snapshot as of 2026-09-26
research_notes: Verified with vendor pages, GitHub repositories, OWASP/GenAI project pages, press releases and Gartner Peer Insights between 2026-09-26 fetches. Web search budget was exhausted mid-task, so a subset of framework pages (MITRE ATLAS, CSA MAESTRO, PLOT4ai, Google SAIF, NIST, shostack.org, prime.security) could not be re-fetched this session; those rows are marked 'unverified this session' where facts rest on prior knowledge. Two premises in the brief did not verify: (1) no public evidence that Secure Code Warrior acquired Threat Canvas - Threat Canvas is a SecureFlag product and SecureFlag/SCW pages make no mention of an acquisition; (2) 'Thagomizer' could not be located as a threat modeling product and is omitted. Two major market events did verify: ThreatModeler acquired IriusRisk (announced 2026-01-08/09) and Security Compass acquired Devici (2025-06-03).

market_trends_2025_2026: Consolidation: ThreatModeler acquired IriusRisk (announced 2026-01-08/09, terms undisclosed; Invictus majority, Paladin minority) and Security Compass acquired Devici (2025-06-03). Three of the four leading commercial platforms now sit in two vendors.

AI-generated threat models from code and IaC moved from demo to GA: SecureFlag Threat Canvas code-repo ingestion (Jan 2026, BYO-LLM), Devici Code Genius, ThreatModeler System Mapping Agent, AWS Threat Composer CLI/MCP on Bedrock, STRIDE GPT agentic repo analysis.

Agentic and MCP-based threat modeling is now standard: MCP servers from ThreatModeler, SD Elements, Devici, Threat Canvas, AWS Labs (two), STRIDE GPT and Tidal; buyers should test them inside Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot rather than only in the vendor UI.
Shift-left into the IDE and PR: DevArmor, Oplane, Heeler and SD Elements for Agentic AI Workflow (Feb 2026) position threat modeling as guardrails for AI coding agents.

Threat modeling of AI systems is catalogue-driven: MAESTRO adopted natively by Devici, ThreatModeler and Aribot; OWASP ASI published Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 and Agent Control Standard (Sept 2026); OWASP LLM Top 10 2026 released 2026-09-01.
Secure Code Warrior runs 'Threat Modeling with AI' webinars (Nov 2025) but no acquisition of Threat Canvas could be verified; Threat Canvas remains a SecureFlag product.

Model-provider lock-in is a procurement issue: IriusRisk Jeff is OpenAI-only with no Azure OpenAI, Seezo is Claude-only, Threat Composer is Bedrock; Threat Canvas and STRIDE GPT are the only surveyed options with true BYO-LLM.

top_3_recommended_contenders.reasoning: Largest combined library, FedRAMP, live cloud and IaC ingestion, MCP server, MAESTRO and EU AI Act mapping. Risk: post-merger roadmap and pricing. Negotiate consolidation commitments and on-prem AI terms.

Best evidence base (4.7/5 on 29 Gartner PI reviews), requirements traceability for audits, Devici gives AI diagram generation, MAESTRO and flat enterprise pricing, MCP for coding agents. Risk: two-product integration and SaaS-only Devici.

Most complete AI-native input coverage (text, diagram, IaC, code) with customer-controlled LLM keys and code kept on-premises, Jira/ADO/MCP delivery, free for OWASP members. Risk: smaller vendor and thin review base; verify ownership.

category_notes.best_oss_pick: OWASP Threat Dragon for a diagram-based system of record (Production status, Git storage, Cornucopia integration), combined with STRIDE GPT (BYO-LLM, MCP, OWASP LLM/ASI and ATLAS mapping) for AI-assisted drafting; AWS Threat Composer for AWS-centric teams.
category_notes.best_framework_for_ai_system_threat_mode: Use MAESTRO (CSA) to decompose agentic systems into seven layers, OWASP Agentic Security Initiative (Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026, Agent Control Standard) plus OWASP LLM Top 10 2026 as the threat catalogue, MITRE ATLAS for adversary techniques, and OWASP AI Exchange for controls and ISO/EU AI Act traceability. Microsoft's AI/ML SDL guidance remains useful for classical ML question sets.
